description: Top 40 arterial road sections for heavy vehicles is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the National Freight Data Hub group, published by Department for Infrastructure and Transport, SA. This ranking lists the 40 busiest arterial sections of road in terms of heavy vehicles. Coverage is South Australia, 2017 to 2018; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2022-10-24. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
